title: Poetry
summary: Play with sound, rhythm and line breaks through haiku, free verse and spoken word, then build a poetry collection.
bigIdeas: A poem can hold a whole moment in a few words.
Poems are made to be heard.

projectSpec.title: My Poetry Collection
projectSpec.description: Gather at least five of your poems (haiku, free verse, spoken word, sound poems or new ones), revise them, put them in an order that tells a story or builds a mood, give the collection a title, and write a short introduction (100–200 words) about what connects them.
